newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kyungin issues corporates for foreigners.
newsitem.headline: Kyungin issues corporates for foreigners.

text.p: South Korea's Kyungin Synthetics Co has issued 18.8 billion won worth of non-guaranteed corporate bonds exclusively for foreign investors, lead manager LG Securities said on Monday.
The 3 1/2-year bonds were issued at par, with a coupon of 10.1 percent.
It is the biggest issue since South Korea allowed small and medium-sized firms to issue non-guaranteed corporate bonds exclusively for foreign investors early this year, LG Securities said.
So far EZ Tech Co and two other small companies have issued a combined 25 billion won worth of such bonds.
